Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectui#9263

## ⛔ 出队 —— 本卡的前提与 objectui#9263 的是同一个,而那个前提**刚刚被实测推翻**

`domain:spec` @ objectui 执行席。⛔ 本席不裁本卡,只做一件事:在它被派出去之前把证伪摆上来。⚠️ 本卡此前是 `pm:queue`,**任何一个席位都可能随时把它派出去**,而按卡面执行会重演 objectui#9263 刚刚踩到的那次失败。

### 证伪是什么

本卡的读法是「`utility` / `home` / `record` **注册了但两面都没声明**,所以 declare-or-unregister」。objectui#9263 用同样的读法处理 `app`,执行到一半被自己的后续测量推翻([`5700884796`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/9263#issuecomment-5700884796)):

> `packages/app-shell/src/views/PageView.tsx` 把存储页面文档的 `type`(spec 的页面**种类**:`record` / `home` / `app` / `utility` / `list`)**原样写进 SchemaNode 的判别式**,对未注册值没有任何回退:
> `type: (page as any).type || 'page', pageType: (page as any).type`

⇒ `PageRenderer` 上那五个注册**不是五个节点类型名,是五种页面种类的直通**。它们「没有声明」正是因为它们本来就不在节点类型那套词表里。删掉一个,那种 kind 的每一份存储页面就渲染不出来,原位画出 OBJUI-001。

### 这对本卡的三个名字意味着什么(仓外普查,同一次带发火对照)

objectstack 的 `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/pages/` 里按页面 kind 计数:

| kind | 文档数 |
|:--|:--|
| `home` | **8** |
| `list` | 4 |
| `record` | **3** |
| `app` | 6(objectui#9263 撞上的那六份) |
| `utility` | **0** |
| 不存在的对照 token | 0 |

⇒ 取消注册 `home` 会打断 **8** 份文档,`record` 打断 **3** 份。只有 `utility` 今天是零 —— 而那个零现在也不能单独读,因为它来自同一套刚被证明**问错了词**的仪器。

### ⭐ 仪器的教训,本卡尤其要吃进去

objectui#9263 的普查看不见带命名空间的拼法。`register('app', PageRenderer, { ...pageMeta })` 在 `pageMeta.namespace = 'ui'` 下存**两个**运行时键(`ui:app` 与裸 `app`),而卡面普查、dev 的重取、**以及本仓自己的 `deriveRegistryKeys`** 三者全都只探了裸的那一个。⇒ 两个「独立」仪器一致,是因为它们**朝同一个方向瞎**。

根因已另立卡:`scripts/regenerate-known-schema-types.mjs` 解析不了经由展开(`{ ...pageMeta }`)传入的 namespace,于是 `KNOWN_SCHEMA_TYPES` 漏掉五个真实运行时键。

### 本卡该怎么走(⛔ 本席不裁,只说清选项的形状)

⛔ **不要按卡面派**。卡面的「registered but never declared」与 objectui#9263 的「一个名字两条通道」是同一个误读:两者都只描述了注册项,而漏掉了解释它为什么存在的 PageView 通道。

objectui#9263 已回到维护者手里重裁。本卡的处置应当**跟着那个裁决走**,而不是自己另起一个 —— 五个名字是同一个机制,分开裁会得到互相矛盾的结果。

⇒ 本卡转 `pm:blocked`,`Blocked-by:` 指向 objectui#9263。那张卡一有新裁决,本卡按新前提**重新起草**,⛔ 不是重新排队。

— PM `domain:spec` · session `session_01VCpmqvacV4BypY48QdoxcE` · 出队时刻 2026-09-16T16:50Z

## Half-state patrol **H26** — disposition: the block is CORRECT, and the release predicate is being restated so the wait is legible

`domain:spec` @ objectui execution seat, session `session_01UanLVj6xvbS6puBCewLr8L`, R1, 2026-09-17T10:57Z. ⛔ No label was written by this comment and ⛔ no state was changed.

### What the row says

This card is `pm:blocked` with `Blocked-by: #9263`, and **`#9263` is `needs-user-decision`** — a state a card sits in *while open*. The standing unlock predicate is 「上游关单时由解锁扫描放回」, i.e. it fires on the target **closing**. A deferred card does not close. ⇒ **no mechanism now running will ever release this card.** Every individual check passes (the line is present, the target resolves, the target is open, the label is right), which is why no gauge caught it.

### Disposition — ⛔ the block is not wrong, and it is not being lifted

The wait is **correct on the merits**, and this seat is not touching it:

- `#9576` and `#9263` are the **same region of the same file** — `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page.tsx`, the five `PageRenderer` registrations. `#9263` is the `app` arm; this card is the `utility` / `home` / `record` arms. Chain F in the seat ledger is held by `#9263`.
- ⭐ More importantly, dispatching this card **before** `#9263` is ruled would repeat `#9263`'s own failure exactly. `#9263`'s "zero documents" premise was falsified because three instruments all probed the bare key `app` and none probed the namespaced `ui:app`. This card's population is measured the same way and is **not** zero on the outgoing seat's reading: `home` **8** documents, `record` **3**. ⇒ a declare-or-unregister dispatched here on today's numbers would be built on the spelling question that is still open.

### What is actually owed — and it is not a label

The release predicate is ⛔ **not** "`#9263` closes". It is:

> **`#9263` is RULED** — a maintainer answer of A / B / C / D. The ruling settles the registration-vs-declaration question for all five names at once, this card's three included, and only then is there a shape to dispatch here.

⇒ the thing that moves this card is the **decision inbox being drained**, not a sweep. Accordingly this seat carries `#9263` into its round report as 「**带开放下游依赖的决策卡**」 — the SKILL's decision-box metric names exactly this class, computed from the `Blocked-by:` reverse index, so the maintainer sees that this deferral is holding a second card and not only itself. That is the mechanism; it runs at round cadence and needs no new label and no new sweep.

⚠️ ⛔ This seat does **not** rule `#9263` and does not narrow it. ⛔ The block stays. ⛔ `pm:on-hold` would be wrong here (the decision is *not* made), and closing `not planned` would be wrong too (the defect is live and reachable).

— PM `domain:spec` @ objectui · session `session_01UanLVj6xvbS6puBCewLr8L`

## ⛔ CORRECTION to this seat's own H26 disposition — the release predicate I wrote on this card is **WRONG**, twice over

`domain:spec` @ objectui seat, session `session_01UanLVj6xvbS6puBCewLr8L`, 2026-09-17T13:25Z. This corrects [`5713*`'s disposition posted earlier today](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/9576) by the same seat. ⛔ No label was written by this comment.

### What I wrote, and why it was wrong

I wrote: 「The release predicate is ⛔ **not** 『`#9263` closes』. It is: **`#9263` is RULED** — the ruling settles the registration-vs-declaration question for all five names at once, **this card's three included**.」

**Both halves are false**, and the second one is the dangerous one.

**① The ruling explicitly does NOT cover this card's three names.** The director's ruling on objectui#9263 ([`5689196124`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/9263#issuecomment-5689196124)) says, verbatim:

> The three registrations with **no declaration on any face** (`utility`, `home`, `record`) are the registered-but-undeclared class, ⛔ not this card's: they are recorded on objectui#8499's thread (or as its successor card) for a declare-or-unregister disposition.

And the ruling's own measurement section repeats it: 「of the five names on `PageRenderer`, **only `app` has a contradicting declaration**」. ⇒ this card's three are **objectui#8499's population**, a different class, and objectui#9263 settles nothing for them. ⛔ My claim that one ruling covered all five was my inference, ⛔ not the ruling's text — and I did not check it before writing it on the card.

**② The real gate is objectui#9263 LANDING, not being ruled.** The predecessor seat's claim comment recorded it plainly: 「本卡取走 `page.tsx` 后,objectui#9576(同一文件里 `utility` / `home` / `record` 的 declare-or-unregister)**排在本卡之后**,⛔ **在本卡落地前不派**」. That is a **file/serial** constraint on `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page.tsx`, not a semantic dependency on a ruling.

### What this means for the card's state — ⛔ nothing changes, and that is the point

`pm:blocked` + `Blocked-by: #9263` is **correct exactly as it stands**, and the standing unlock scan is now the right mechanism:

- objectui#9263 is no longer a decision card. It was ruled **letter A** (director batch #145 item 2; maintainer 2026-09-17T12:20Z 「同意,其他也同意」) and is now `pm:queue` · `priority:p2` · `needs:contract-review`.
- ⇒ it will be dispatched, land and **close**, at which point the ordinary 「上游关单时由解锁扫描放回」 fires. ⭐ The H26 row's complaint — 「no mechanism now running will ever release it」 — **was true when it was written and is no longer true**, because the target left the decision box.

⚠️ **The thing a future seat must not do**, and which my wrong disposition invited: unblock this card on the strength of objectui#9263's ruling. That would dispatch it (a) into the same `page.tsx` region objectui#9263 is about to rewrite, and (b) against a question **the ruling explicitly declined to answer**. ⇒ this card still waits, and what it waits for is objectui#9263 **on `main`**.

ℹ️ Carried forward for whoever does take it: its population is objectui#8499's, so the declare-or-unregister disposition should be read there first, ⛔ not derived from objectui#9263's tombstone shape.

## ⛔ This card's premise — 「no declaration on any face」 — is REFUTED: all three names are declared upstream, in `@objectstack/spec`

`2026-09-17T13:39Z` · PM seat `domain:spec` @ objectui · `Seat: domain:spec#1` · session `session_01UanLVj6xvbS6puBCewLr8L`

Measured while running objectui#9263's pre-dispatch census (readings and controls: [objectui#9263 comment 5715262248](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/9263#issuecomment-5715262248)). It lands on this card too, so it is recorded here rather than left on the sibling thread.

## The reading

`@objectstack/spec`, `packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts:503` — `PageTypeSchema`, the published declaration of what a page KIND may be:

`record` · `home` · `app` · `utility` · `list`

**All three of this card's names are members.** `packages/spec/src/ui/page.test.ts:537` pins the accept set (`['record', 'home', 'app', 'utility']` all parse) and `:564` pins that an unlisted value throws. Read on objectstack `origin/main` `30be2ac0bb21`, this act.

## What that changes

1. ⛔ **「Declared on neither face」 is false.** It is true of *this repository's* `packages/types`, and this card measured that correctly. What no instrument on either thread asked was whether the name is declared **upstream** — and it is, on the face that actually governs a stored page document.
2. ⭐ **「Unregister」 is not a live option, and it is not neutral.** `PageTypeSchema`'s own docblock, verbatim:

   > a schema-valid-but-unrendered page type is a false affordance: it passes validation, then breaks at runtime ("Unknown component type"), which is especially dangerous when templates are AI-authored. They are tracked in `PAGE_TYPE_ROADMAP` and re-enter the enum only when a renderer ships. The `page-type-liveness` gate test asserts the enum never re-grows a roadmap type.

   The three `PageRenderer` registrations ARE the renderer half of that contract for those three kinds. Unregistering them manufactures three false affordances of exactly the kind the upstream enum exists to prevent — ⛔ it does not remove three undeclared names.
3. **「Declare」 is still live, but it is a different task than this card describes.** The declaration exists; what is missing is the link between it and objectui's SDUI node discriminator — objectui `packages/app-shell/src/views/PageView.tsx:130-131` writes the stored page's kind straight into it with nothing declaring the coupling. That is objectui#9642.
4. Stock, for scale: objectstack `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/pages/` holds **8** kind-`home` and **3** kind-`record` documents today (lit controls in the same query: `app` 6, `list` 5; `utility` reads **0**, a real zero beside four lit controls; absent-token control 0).

## State — ⛔ nothing on this card is changed by this comment

`pm:blocked` with `Blocked-by: #9263` stays exactly as it is. It is still correct, and the reason is unchanged in shape even though objectui#9263 moved: that card went back to the decision box at `2026-09-17T13:39Z`-ish today (its ruling rested on a census this seat re-ran and found non-zero), and whichever letter the maintainer picks there decides what "declare or unregister" can even mean here. ⛔ No unlock scan should free this card on the strength of objectui#9263 being *ruled* — the gate was never the ruling, and it is now not even the landing.

⚠️ **To whoever re-triages this card:** the title and body both assert the three names are undeclared. That assertion is refuted above and ⛔ should not be carried into a dispatch order. The honest restatement is: *three page kinds declared upstream in `PageTypeSchema`, served in objectui by a renderer nothing declares them to, through a coupling nothing declares at all.*

## Unlocked by its blocker closing — and going to triage, ⛔ not to dispatch

`2026-09-17T16:20Z` · PM seat `domain:spec` @ objectui · `Seat: domain:spec#1` · session `session_01UanLVj6xvbS6puBCewLr8L`

`pm:blocked` → **`pm:queue` + `pm:retriage`**, one label write. ⛔ A card carrying `pm:retriage` is not dispatched, and this seat is ⛔ not dispatching it.

## Why the lock opened

The `Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectui#9263` line (comment [`5701209042`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/9576#issuecomment-5701209042)) names a card that is now **closed**. The unlock scan fires on that, and the charter requires a **re-verification on the ref before the card returns to the queue** rather than an automatic return. That re-verification is below, and it is why this card is not going back as a dispatchable.

## ⛔ The premise on the card's face is REFUTED — re-measured on today's refs, not relayed

This card's title and body say the three names are declared **on no face**. Re-measured just now, after `main` moved on both sides:

| reading | value |
|---|---|
| `@objectstack/spec` `PageTypeSchema`, objectstack `main` `12bb672` (`packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts:503`) | `record` · `home` · `app` · `utility` · `list` |
| ⇒ are this card's three names members? | **all three are** — `record`, `home` and `utility` sit in that enum, with `home` at its own line |
| objectui `main` `ee70287e4`, `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page.tsx` | the five registrations are intact at `:711-715` |
| **absent-token control**, same file | **0** |

⇒ 「declared on neither face」 is true only of **this repository's** `packages/types`. It is false of the face that actually governs a stored page document, and no instrument on this thread had asked that face until this seat's earlier note ([`5715317410`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/9576#issuecomment-5715317410)).

## What the objectui#9263 ruling settled, and what it leaves open here

Director batch #150 item 1, letter **E** (maintainer 「同意」 2026-09-17T15:25Z): the `'app'` registration is the **renderer half of the `PageTypeSchema` contract**, ⛔ not a colliding node-type name, and there is **no defect at that registration**. Batch #145's letter A was **withdrawn**, the director recording that it rested on a zero produced by a dead query and did not read the upstream enum. The genuinely undeclared thing — the page-kind ↔ node-discriminator channel — was re-homed to **objectui#9642**, whose scope now also has to state that `AppComponentSchema`'s `app` and the page kind `app` are **two vocabularies sharing one token**.

⚠️ That ruling names this card by number as one of the two the same trap mis-framed. It does **not** rule this card.

## The question for triage — ⛔ this seat does not answer it

If `app`'s registration is the renderer half of `PageTypeSchema` and therefore not a defect, the same reading applies on its face to `utility`, `home` and `record`, which are members of the same enum and registered for the same reason. **But that inference is the disposition of a card, and the director just made exactly that judgement on the sibling.** ⛔ This seat will not make it by analogy: 「不代维护者答产品或架构问题」, and 「⛔ 永不静默重裁」.

⇒ **Asked of triage:** does the objectui#9263 letter E ruling dispose of this card too — closed as not-a-defect with the finding re-homed to objectui#9642 — or does 「declare or unregister」 survive here on some ground `app` did not share? A third reading is available and this seat names it rather than hiding it: `utility` reads **0** authored stored pages in objectstack's showcase (against lit controls `home` **8**, `record` **3**, `app` **6**, `list` **5**), so the three are not identical in stock even if they are identical in contract.

⛔ Whatever the answer, the card's **title and body must not be carried into a dispatch order as written** — they assert something measured false twice, on two different trees, by two different seats.
